experiment_kind: development manipulation diagnostic; not efficacy and not confirmatory
research_chain: thesis research -> design choice -> future ARGO contract -> future in-period NAIS implementation

decision_target.question: Should the ARGO MVP use typed evidence dependency/version control, or a simpler result-driven experiment tree as its research-state policy?

hypothesis.statement: When a source dependency is invalidated, a typed dependency policy changes only dependent decisions and preserves unrelated valid results more reliably than an opportunity-matched result-tree policy, while enabling the same fresh-context next action to be reconstructed.

comparison.proximity_policy: held fixed as candidate-ranking opportunity if used; not varied in this diagnostic
comparison.declared_difference: research-state control policy and its pre-registered code hash only

scenario_design.intervention: invalidate the sole source edge supporting one admitted decision after a downstream result exists
scenario_design.expected_typed_action: mark only the dependent decision/action requires_recheck; block its successor; preserve independent result bytes
scenario_design.discriminates: dependency-aware selective reopening versus generic tree continuation or global reset

scenario_design.intervention: change a source edge outside the admitted decision dependency closure
scenario_design.expected_typed_action: preserve admitted decision, allowed next action, and valid result
scenario_design.discriminates: targeted dependency use versus change-anything pivot behavior

scenario_design.intervention: give a new agent only the frozen snapshot, reviewed spans, invalidation event, receipts, and permission/budget state
scenario_design.expected_typed_action: recover the same allowed next action and exact forbidden reasons without conversation history
scenario_design.discriminates: persistent operational state versus local narrative recall

primary_manipulation_checks: policy state was actually read before action
relevant invalidation changes the dependency-reachable action
unrelated perturbation does not change unrelated decision/result
handoff reconstructs allowed action and forbidden reasons
outcomes.scoring: deterministic decision contract; never LLM judge
outcomes.interpretation_limit: a pass proves manipulation and contract behavior in the fixture only; it is not population efficacy

population_and_unit.population: public scientific-choice/reproducibility capsules with competing explanations and independently checkable observations
population_and_unit.nested_repeats: rollout/API calls within task; not independent n

analysis.reason_unfilled: task pack, manipulation rate, variance, and exact cost are not measured

execution.environment_digest: runtime-derived python executable SHA-256 in receipt; stdlib-only runner
execution.reason: runner, capsule, expected outcomes, code hashes, zero model/tool calls, and 30-second ceiling are fixed; this is not paid or efficacy execution

falsifiers: typed policy not consumed before decision
relevant and unrelated perturbations cause the same transition
fresh-context answer depends on hidden conversation
runner accesses hidden gold during refine

result_to_design.result: typed manipulation passes, comparator manipulation passes
result_to_design.next: task-pack development and cost/precision design; still no efficacy claim
do not include typed control in prototype candidate; repair or prefer simpler result tree
repair comparator rather than declare typed superiority

result_to_design.result: both pass but later efficacy is precise null
result_to_design.next: prefer simpler result tree; retain graph as audit/export only

result_to_design.result: typed policy later wins within approved confirmatory contract
result_to_design.next: promote typed research-state contract to future native implementation candidate

nais_effect_if_selected: future in-period prototype must show at least two actually executed candidates, same-basis comparison, reasoned pruning, one observation-driven successor, and fresh-context handoff; this manifest is not that implementation
